detail.whyPerPixelIsHigher: The graded edit is softer than the raw clips (horizontal luma gradient energy 2.30 vs 2.57 on a matched frame) and re-encoded; no color transform can model that. On 4×4 block means the same transform reaches 1.48 on a single matched frame (the planning session's 1.5). A quadratic color model would lower block RMS to 1.18 on that frame; CGA keeps the planned 3×3 + offset.
detail.heldOutClip: Woman_stepping_forward (not in the edit) has no graded counterpart; the look applied to it renders at 1.75 RMS from the exact prediction (H.264 loss).

findings: The owner's graded edit is tagged BT.709 transfer while the Flow sources are sRGB. The media path converts BT.709 transfer to sRGB on import, but comp render writes sRGB-encoded pixels tagged BT.709 without conversion, so an export→import round trip brightens midtones (≈ +5% median luma on the owner's edit). look fit therefore compares the graded edit in code values by default. This import/export asymmetry predates CGA and is not changed here.

Measured against correctly decoded (BT.601) raw clips, the owner's grade is: neutral gains R 0.955 / G 0.961 / B 1.034 (cooler), luma −4.9%, offsets < 0.01; the median chroma ratio is 1.00 (saturation moved within colors rather than uniformly). The planning session's '×1.48 saturation' was a different decomposition; the transform itself agrees.

The raw clips' near-neutral cast estimate is warm (temperature −17…−41 to neutralize) with a large per-pixel spread (~18–19): the near-neutral set mixes beige, white and gray, so the solver removes only 40% of it. The owner's grade removed about a third (graded estimate −28).
rejected: Fitting the look on the media-path decode of the BT.709-transfer edit: offsets 0.08 and luma +0.5%, a tone change a 3×3 cannot model (RMS 1.93 per pixel but the wrong transform).
Fitting on single pixels: codec noise and softening dominate; 4×4 block means give the same transform with a cleaner fit.
Full neutral-cast removal (75%): neutralized the beige scenes and dropped median saturation from 0.12 to 0.05.
Key-preserving gamma with the black point: overshot the median on symmetric contrast compression; levels use gamma 1.
Brightening clips whose highlights stay below 0.9 regardless of key: raised high-key Flow medians by +0.10.
The repository's batch command for folders: it runs v0.1 image-animation requests, not compositions; auto-color handles folders itself with a summary file.
